items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 43:1
items.html: The oath concerns a fully complete coupling, meaning of the aspect of feet touching feet, as it was in the time of the Kings, and as it shall be at the end of correction, for only this is called a fully complete coupling. And God swore that He would not enter into a fully complete coupling in the Jerusalem above, until He enters into a fully complete coupling in the Jerusalem below. (Ibid., Sub Header, “Now.”)
